title: The Paired Heartleaf Course
summary: A school course in paired leaves of qi that cut and mend by turns and ends in the twin bloom of the heartleaf.

title: Manual of the Azure Court Yew
summary: A school manual of the yew of the azure court whose bitter wood poisons the blade and shields the bearer.

title: The Twin River Ash Canon
summary: A school canon of two streams of ash wood qi that run together and meet at one point in the closing stroke.

title: Treatise of the Hawk Dive and Basin Oak
summary: A school treatise that joins the diving strike of the hawk with the settled strength of the basin oak.

title: Canon of the Hawk's Highest Crownwood
summary: A school canon for those with a formed Core on the crownwood where the hawk rests and its great flowering.

title: The Wind-Sworn Larch Course
summary: A school course in the sworn larch of the Gale academies whose needles fall and rise again with the wind.

title: Manual of the Oath Rooted in Rock
summary: A school manual of the juniper that roots in bare rock and carries its oath through every cut and mend.

title: The Gale Bearing Hawthorn Canon
summary: A school canon of the hawthorn that keeps its bearing in the gale and grows its thorns where the wind hits hardest.

title: The Great Sway of the Wind-Sworn Alder
summary: A school text on the great sway of the wind-sworn alder from the first bend to the full-grown storm.

title: Canon of the Tree That No Gale Uproots
summary: A school canon for those with a formed Core on the great banyan that no gale can tear from its ground.
